🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica

🚨 CVE-2026-123903 - VMware
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Broadcom has evaluated the severity of this issue to be in the Critical severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 9.8. Affected versions: VMware vCenter Server 9.1.x.x: fixed in 9.1.2 VMware vCenter Server 9.0.x.x: fixed in 9.0.2.0300 VMware vCenter Server 8.0: fixed in 8.0 U3m VMware Cloud Foundation 5.x: fixed i...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123903
 
🚨 CVE-2026-82490 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting. Any authenticated account, inclu...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-82490
 
🚨 CVE-2026-77230 - Elastic
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elast...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77230
 
🚨 CVE-2026-135124 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A race condition during docker cp mount setup in Docker Engine allows a malicious container to leave a read-only bind mount writable while an archive is extracted into the container. When copying files into a container, the daemon bind-mounts the container's volumes into a temporary view and applies the read-only flags afterwards, through a path inside the container's filesystem. A process in the container can change...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135124

🚨 New NFS2ROOT Linux flaw can let attackers gain root privileges
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
​A 12-year-old critical vulnerability in the Linux kernel's Network File System (NFS) server, tracked as CVE-2026-99362, allows remote attackers to gain root privileges.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-nfs2root-linux-flaw-can-let-attackers-gain-root-privileges/
 
🚨 CVE-2026-81410 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 2.9
Resumo:
Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the LOCATION URL in a UPnP response without checking that it points to the responding host. An attacker on the local network who answers the script's discovery broadcast can supply a LOCATION URL for an arbitrary host, port and path, including i...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-81410
 
💣 Drupal warns of new site takeover flaw exploited in attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Drupal security team says attackers are exploiting a second critical vulnerability that lets them breach and hijack unpatched websites.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/drupal-warns-of-new-access-bypass-flaw-exploited-in-attacks/
 
💣 Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access

Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti, an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution. The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE identifier, has been tracked as 4HTTP2SHELL and 4HTTP2ROOT. 💣 Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/remus-malware-steals-gmail-messages-via-fake-google-sheets-extension/
 
📰 In Other News: Tanker Cyberattacks, EU Quantum Act, New VirusTotal Capabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta

📰 Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday. Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/switzerland-confirms-ai-assisted.html

Sistemas / Cloud - 1Password / Azure / Office / Ubuntu / Windows Server / WordPress

🚨 CVE-2026-137566 - Azure
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Azure
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
Argo Workflows 3.0.0 through 3.7.18, 4.0.0 before 4.0.12, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the S3, GCS, and Azure Blob artifact drivers. Attackers who can write bucket objects or supply malicious artifact sources can use object keys containing ../ sequences to write arbitrary files in the executor pod, achieving code execution.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-137566
 
🚨 CVE-2026-136500 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
To escape a bound parameter, or a name passed to a catalog function, psqlODBC has to know where each multibyte character of the client encoding ends. It treated a client encoding named by an alias the server accepts, such as WIN950, Windows950 or big-5 for BIG5, as single-byte, and it accepted too narrow a range of lead bytes for JOHAB, EUC_TW, EUC_CN and EUC_KR. A quote byte that the server reads as part of such a c...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-136500
 
🚨 USN-9212-1: PyJWT vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
It was discovered that PyJWT incorrectly handled errors when parsing deeply nested token headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using PyJWT to fail unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-102265) It was discovered that PyJWT modified the options mapping supplied by an application when signature verification was disabled. If an application reused that mapping for a l...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9212-1
 
🚨 USN-9206-1: Guava vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
It was discovered that Guava did not correctly handle permissions for certain temporary directories. An attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive information. (CVE-2020-8908, CVE-2023-2976) Kaya Emre Arikan discovered that Guava did not correctly handle deserializing certain data. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9206-1
 
🚨 USN-9213-1: libXi vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Adam Bedard discovered that libXi did not properly validate DEVICE_RESOLUTION replies from the X server, which could result in a heap buffer overflow. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using libXi to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-109089) Adam Bedard discovered that libXi did not properly allocate memory when handling DEVICE_ENABLE replies from the X server. A r...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9213-1
 
🚨 CVE-2026-135483 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.4
Resumo:
Author Avatars List/Block plugin for WordPress before 2.2.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to inject arbitrary JavaScript via the card_min_width, card_max_width, card_min_height, and card_max_height attributes of the [authoravatars] shortcode. Attackers can supply a value containing a double quote to break out of the card...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135483
